name: Touchstone Reviews
author: developercrack

sections.description:
Write a review of anything. Touchstone Reviews turns it into a good-looking review box with the review schema Google asks for.

Phones, books, coffee grinders, software, hotels: add a score, pros and cons, and a verdict, and the plugin does the rest.

What you get

  • A review box that fits your site. It uses your theme’s fonts and colors right away.
  • Correct Google review schema. Each review is checked before it goes on the page. If something is missing, the plugin tells you what to add.
  • Your own scores and criteria. Score out of 5, 10 or 100, with any criteria you like.
  • One dashboard for every review. See each score and article, and spot the reviews that need attention.
  • Your look, your way. Three layouts, seven color palettes, and stars, bars or numbers.
  • Free, with every feature. One download with no limit on reviews.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open a post and add the Review box block.
  3. Fill in the name, scores, and pros and cons. The preview updates as you type.
  4. Publish.

Manage all reviews under Reviews in your dashboard. Change the look under Reviews, Style.

Built for search

It creates valid Google review schema for products, books, films, software and games, and tells you when a score would make it invalid.

Also included

  • Works in the block editor and the classic editor, with a [touchstone_review] shortcode
  • A list block for sidebars and “best of” pages
  • Move your reviews over from Taqyeem or WP Review, with a preview first and undo
  • Fast pages: no scripts added, and styles only load where a review appears
  • Keyboard and screen reader friendly, translatable and right-to-left ready
  • Your reviews stay in your database and are kept if you remove the plugin

Source code

The block editor scripts in build/ are compiled from the readable source in the blocks/ folder, which ships with the plugin. To build them yourself: npm install, then npm run build (Node 22).
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins, Add New, search for “Touchstone Reviews”, then Install and Activate.
  2. Open a post and add the “Review box” block.
  3. Fill in the review. Publish.

Classic editor? Fill in the “Review box” under the editor and add [touchstone_review] where it should appear.
sections.faq:
Will my reviews show stars in Google?

Your reviews get the schema Google asks for, and the plugin tells you if anything is missing. Google decides whether to show stars. It does not show them for reviews of your own business or products.

What can I review?

Anything: products, books, films, software, games, places or services. Pick a category or make your own criteria.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The box takes your theme’s fonts and colors. Change anything under Reviews, Style.

Can visitors leave ratings?

No. This plugin is for your own reviews, not customer ratings.

I use Taqyeem or WP Review. Can I switch?

Yes. Reviews, Import shows what it found before saving anything, and your old data is never changed.

What happens to my reviews if I delete the plugin?

They stay in your database unless you choose to delete them in the settings first.

Is there a Pro version?

No. Every feature described here is in this free plugin.
